title: How to change someone’s mind
blurb: Reported questions, and the prepositions that come with them

steps.title: What has changed your mind about something recently?

options.label: somebody argued with me and won
somebody asked me a question I couldn’t answer
I saw something with my own eyes
nothing — I don’t think I’ve changed my mind about anything
